title: Reformed Baptist Church in 1980
description: The church was rededicated on January 4, 1914, after a 20 x 23-foot addition was built at the rear. Members of the Wesleyan Church (formerly Reformed Baptist Church) held their final service in the Hartland church on September 16, 1984. Starting Wednesday, September 19, 1984, all services moved to the new location in Somerville.
